answer: Resist sybils with stake-bonded vouching: a new identity joins only when two established agents vouch for it, each staking part of their own locked balance, and each voucher may sponsor just two newcomers per epoch. An honest agent begins its voyage with a genuine introduction, its pulse of real work checked by sponsors who risk their own stake. A farmer's thousand clones face a delta of scarce trust: every fake needs two real sponsors spending a limited slot and risking a slash. Buying a thousand vouches costs more than the clones earn.
